items.heading: Mumu
details: Key ingredients: pork, sweet potato, greens, hot stones
Heat stones in a fire pit until glowing hot.
Layer pork, sweet potato and greens over the hot stones in a pit.
Cover the pit with leaves and soil to trap the heat.
Cook for hours, then uncover and serve the smoky, tender food.

items.heading: Kokoda PNG
details: Key ingredients: fish, coconut milk, lime juice, vegetables
Cure raw fish chunks in fresh lime juice.
Mix in coconut milk and diced vegetables.
Chill until the fish turns opaque and the flavors meld.
Serve cold as a refreshing dish.
